message.content:
Below is a concise “long‑weekend” calendar for Canada in 2023.  
It lists the federal holidays that create a three‑day weekend (holiday on a Friday or Monday, or a holiday that falls on a weekend and is observed on the following Monday).  Provincial holidays that also generate long weekends are noted where applicable.

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Observed On (if weekend) | Notes / Province(s) |
|-------------|---------|-------------|--------------------------|---------------------|
| **Jan 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | **Jan 2** (Monday) | Federal holiday; observed on Monday. Creates a long weekend (Dec 31–Jan 2). |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day | Monday | — | Provincial holiday in Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island. Creates a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | — | Federal holiday; long weekend (Apr 7–9). |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | — | Federal holiday; long weekend (May 20–22). |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | **Jul 3** (Monday) | Federal holiday; observed on Monday. Creates a long weekend (Jul 1–3). |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | — | Federal holiday; long weekend (Sep 2–4). |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | — | Federal holiday; long weekend (Oct 7–9). |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Monday | — | Observed as a statutory holiday in many provinces (e.g., Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, Saskatchewan). Creates a long weekend in those provinces. |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | — | Federal holiday; long weekend (Dec 23–25). |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | — | Federal holiday, but falls on a Tuesday – no long weekend. |

### Quick Take‑away

- **Federal long weekends (applicable nationwide):** Jan 1 (observed Jan 2), Apr 7, May 22, Jul 1 (observed Jul 3), Sep 4, Oct 9, Dec 25.
- **Provincial long weekends (depending on your province):** Feb 20 (Family Day), Nov 11 (Remembrance Day).

Feel free to filter the table by province if your holiday‑planning app needs province‑specific data. If you’d like the full list of statutory holidays for each province, let me know and I can compile that as well.
